name: CoinGlass
description: Crypto derivatives data from CoinGlass: futures open interest across exchanges, funding rates (also open-interest weighted), long/short ratios of all and top traders, liquidations, options max pain, spot bitcoin and ether ETF flows, stablecoin market cap, Coinbase premium and the Fear & Greed Index. Read-only; needs a CoinGlass API plan.
instructions:
## CoinGlass
This connector reads crypto derivatives and market data from the **CoinGlass API v4** (`https://open-api-v4.coinglass.com`): futures open interest, funding rates, long/short ratios, liquidations, options max pain, spot ETF flows and market indicators such as the stablecoin market cap, the Fear & Greed Index and the Coinbase premium. Everything is read-only.

**Setup (2 minutes)**
1. CoinGlass API access needs a paid API plan (Hobbyist and up) at https://www.coinglass.com/pricing.
2. Open your account's **API Key** page (https://www.coinglass.com/account), copy the key into `COINGLASS_API_KEY`. It is sent in the `CG-API-KEY` header.
3. Run `coinglass_get_account_subscription` to check the key and see the plan.

**Plans and limits**: requests per minute depend on the plan (Hobbyist 30, Startup 80, Standard 300, Professional 1200). History tools limit the interval on the smaller plans: Hobbyist only `4h` and longer, Startup `30m` and longer, Standard and up any interval. History depth per interval also grows with the plan; daily data goes back to the start on every plan. A call outside the plan answers with an error message in the body; switch to a longer interval rather than retrying.

**Symbols: coin or pair**
- Coin-level tools take a coin as `symbol` (`BTC`, `ETH`): `coinglass_get_aggregated_open_interest_history`, `coinglass_list_open_interest_by_exchange`, `coinglass_get_oi_weighted_funding_rate_history`, `coinglass_get_aggregated_liquidation_history`, `coinglass_get_pairs_markets`, `coinglass_get_option_max_pain`. `coinglass_list_supported_coins` lists the coins.
- Pair-level tools take an `exchange` (`Binance`, `OKX`, `Bybit`, spelled as `coinglass_list_supported_exchanges` returns) and a pair as `symbol` (`BTCUSDT`): `coinglass_get_price_history`, `coinglass_get_open_interest_history`, `coinglass_get_funding_rate_history`, `coinglass_get_global_long_short_account_ratio`, `coinglass_get_top_long_short_account_ratio`, `coinglass_get_top_long_short_position_ratio`, `coinglass_get_liquidation_history`. `coinglass_list_exchange_pairs` lists the pairs of an exchange.

**Workflow**
- Positioning of a coin: `coinglass_get_aggregated_open_interest_history` (all exchanges) and `coinglass_list_open_interest_by_exchange` (where it sits now), `coinglass_get_oi_weighted_funding_rate_history` for crowding, `coinglass_list_funding_rates_by_exchange` for the current rates, `coinglass_get_global_long_short_account_ratio` and the two top-trader ratios on Binance, `coinglass_get_liquidation_history` or `coinglass_get_aggregated_liquidation_history` for forced closes.
- Market overview: `coinglass_get_pairs_markets` for every pair of a coin with price, volume, open interest and funding.
- Flows and sentiment: `coinglass_get_bitcoin_etf_flows`, `coinglass_get_ethereum_etf_flows`, `coinglass_list_bitcoin_etfs`, `coinglass_get_stablecoin_market_cap_history`, `coinglass_get_coinbase_premium_index`, `coinglass_get_fear_greed_history`.
- Options: `coinglass_get_option_max_pain`.

**History tools** take `interval` (required), `limit` (points, maximum 1000), and optionally `start_time` / `end_time` in **Unix milliseconds**. Ask for only what you need, e.g. `interval: 1d, limit: 30` for a month of daily points. Returned `time` values are milliseconds, except the Coinbase premium, the stablecoin market cap and the Fear & Greed lists, which use seconds. Funding rates are in percent per funding interval (0.01 means 0.01%).

**Errors**: CoinGlass answers HTTP 200 with a `code` other than "0" when something is wrong: 401 or "Invalid API key" for a missing or wrong key, 429 when the per-minute limit is used up, 400 for a wrong parameter or a call the plan does not include.
prerequisites: A CoinGlass account with a paid API plan (Hobbyist or higher) and its API key.

COINGLASS_API_KEY.label: API key
COINGLASS_API_KEY.help: CoinGlass, account, API Key: the key of your API plan. It is sent in the CG-API-KEY header.
COINGLASS_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste only the API key, without spaces or quotes.

verifyHints.401: CoinGlass refused the API key. Copy it again from your CoinGlass account (API Key page); a key without an active API plan does not work.
verifyHints.429: The per-minute request limit of your CoinGlass plan is used up. Wait a minute and try again.

tools.name: coinglass_get_account_subscription
tools.description: Show the CoinGlass API plan of the key (level such as HOBBYIST, STARTUP, STANDARD, PROFESSIONAL), its expiry time and whether it has expired. Use it to check the key and to know which intervals the plan allows.

tools.name: coinglass_list_supported_coins
tools.description: List the coins CoinGlass covers for futures data (BTC, ETH, SOL, ...). These are the values the coin-level tools take as symbol.

tools.name: coinglass_list_supported_exchanges
tools.description: List the futures exchanges CoinGlass covers (Binance, OKX, Bybit, Deribit, CME, Hyperliquid, ...), spelled as the exchange parameter expects.

tools.name: coinglass_list_exchange_pairs
tools.description: List the futures trading pairs per exchange: instrument_id (the pair the pair-level tools take as symbol, e.g. BTCUSDT), base and quote asset. Filter by one exchange to keep the answer short.

exchange.description: Only pairs of this exchange, e.g. Binance.

tools.name: coinglass_get_pairs_markets
tools.description: Current market snapshot of every futures pair of a coin across exchanges: price, index price, 24 hour price change, volume, long and short volume, open interest, funding rate and 24 hour liquidations per pair.

symbol.description: Coin symbol, e.g. BTC or ETH. coinglass_list_supported_coins lists them.

tools.name: coinglass_get_price_history
tools.description: Price candles (open, high, low, close, volume_usd) of one futures pair on one exchange.

exchange.description: Futures exchange name as CoinGlass writes it, e.g. Binance, OKX, Bybit, Gate, HTX. coinglass_list_exchange_pairs lists the exchanges and their pairs.

symbol.description: Trading pair on that exchange, e.g. BTCUSDT or ETHUSDT (instrument_id from coinglass_list_exchange_pairs).

interval.description: Candle interval: 1m, 3m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 6h, 8h, 12h, 1d or 1w. The Hobbyist plan only allows 4h and longer, Startup 30m and longer.

limit.description: Number of candles; CoinGlass requires it, default here 100, maximum 1000.

start_time.description: Start of the range, Unix milliseconds.

end_time.description: End of the range, Unix milliseconds.

tools.name: coinglass_get_bitcoin_etf_flows
tools.description: Daily net flows of the US spot bitcoin ETFs: total flow_usd per day, the BTC price, and the flow of each ETF (IBIT, FBTC, GBTC, ...). Positive is inflow. Covers every day since the ETFs launched.

tools.name: coinglass_get_ethereum_etf_flows
tools.description: Daily net flows of the US spot ether ETFs: total flow_usd per day, the ETH price, and the flow of each ETF (ETHA, FETH, ...). Positive is inflow.

tools.name: coinglass_list_bitcoin_etfs
tools.description: List the spot bitcoin ETFs with ticker, fund name, region, primary exchange, market status, assets under management, management fee, volume, BTC holdings with 24 hour and 7 day change, net asset value and premium or discount.

tools.name: coinglass_get_stablecoin_market_cap_history
tools.description: History of the total stablecoin market capitalisation with the BTC price alongside: parallel lists data_list (market cap, USD), price_list and time_list (Unix seconds). A rising stablecoin supply means fresh cash entering crypto.

tools.name: coinglass_get_fear_greed_history
tools.description: History of the Crypto Fear & Greed Index (0 extreme fear to 100 extreme greed) with the BTC price alongside: parallel lists data_list, price_list and time_list (Unix seconds).

tools.name: coinglass_get_coinbase_premium_index
tools.description: Coinbase premium index: the gap between the BTC price on Coinbase (USD) and on Binance (USDT), as premium in USD and premium_rate (0.0261 = 2.61%). Positive means US buyers pay more. time is in Unix seconds.
